description: A utility module containing functions for condition checking, message processing, schema conversion, conversation history filtering, message restructuring, and class definitions for tools and runnables within a language model framework.

classes.name: ExtractTool
classes.description: A structured tool class for extracting structured data from output, extending StructuredTool.

classes.name: RunnableCallable
classes.description: A class extending Runnable to wrap functions with additional configuration, tracing, and recursion capabilities.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates a condition on input, supporting string and numeric comparisons.

methods.name: transformObjectPropertyToFunction
methods.description: Transforms object properties into functions, resolving message content and state references.

methods.name: processImageMessage
methods.description: Processes image messages for vision-enabled language models, adding images and switching models as needed.

methods.name: customGet
methods.description: Retrieves nested object properties, supporting negative indices for arrays.

methods.name: convertStructuredSchemaToZod
methods.description: Converts a JSON schema into a Zod validation schema object.

methods.name: filterConversationHistory
methods.description: Filters conversation history based on selected options like last message, user question, or all messages.

methods.name: restructureMessages
methods.description: Restructures messages for compatibility with different LLMs, handling tool messages and message order.

methods.name: checkMessageHistory
methods.description: Evaluates and injects message history into prompts based on node data and options.
